title: fespalier
description: The fespalier: section of pubspec.yaml: what fsp reads. Every key is optional. https://github.com/fespalier/fespalier/blob/main/docs/configuration.md

app_dir.description: The folder fsp reads, relative to the project root and under lib/.

output.description: Where fsp gen writes, a .dart file under lib/. The generated main() goes beside it, with .main.g.dart. build_runner can delete a .g.dart that has an X.dart beside it (since 0.17.0 fsp warns).

format.description: Run dart format on the generated file (needs dart on PATH).

output_manifest.description: Write the route manifest (AppManifest) to a library of its own, a .dart file under lib/. Default: none, the manifest lives in output.

meta.description: required: every route needs a meta.dart.

meta_unique.description: Named arguments of meta's constructor whose literal value no two routes may share, like [code, slug].

case_sensitive.description: Whether paths match by case. A route.dart sets it per folder (const caseSensitive).

remount.description: When a page gets a fresh state because its URL changed (since 0.6.0). A route.dart sets it per folder (const remount).

deferred.description: Each page's code loads on demand: a chunk of its own on the web (since 0.7.0). A route.dart sets it per folder (const deferred).

data_retry.description: What a failed data() provider does: inherit is the ProviderScope's retry, none gives it retry: null.

keep_previous.description: Keep showing the previous value or error while data.dart reloads; false shows loading.dart instead.

push_updates_url.description: A pushed route's URL is in the browser's address bar, as go's is (since 0.6.0).

file_style.description: How fsp init and fsp new spell a multi-word file kind: not_found.dart or not-found.dart. Reading takes both.

lints.description: One level per lint over the app's own code (since 0.7.0).

unknown_path.description: A string path passed to the router that matches no route: warning, error (fails gen and check) or off.

semantics_ids.description: Every page wears Semantics(identifier: 'route:/...'), for Maestro (since 0.7.0).

scroll_restoration.description: The browser's back and forward bring a page's scroll offsets back (since 0.8.1).

telemetry.description: Report navigations, guards, data, actions and deferred loads to FespalierTelemetry (since 0.8.1).

otel.description: The generated main() starts otel_zone and installs FespalierOtel (since 0.19.0). Needs telemetry: true, fespalier_otel and otel_zone under dependencies:, and main other than manual.

main.description: Whether fsp writes the generated main() (AppMain, beside output): auto when the app folder's root has an app.dart, startup.dart or splash.dart (or adapters: or otel: say so), generated always, manual never (since 0.8.1).

adapters.description: Packages that plug into the generated main() through package:<name>/fespalier_adapter.dart (since 0.9.0): a list of package names under dependencies:, the first the outermost; or auto (since 0.23.0), every first-party adapter package under dependencies:, in their order there.

links.description: What fsp links writes: App Links, Universal Links and a sitemap (since 0.5.0). Only fsp links checks the values; fsp gen reads the first of domains for AppRoutes.urlOf (since 0.16.0).

domains.description: The host names the app opens, like shop.example.com; the first is the sitemap's and AppRoutes.urlOf's.

scheme.description: A custom URL scheme in lower case, like myshop.

scheme_host.description: false: the scheme's links have no host, myshop:///path (since 0.11.0).

paths.description: What the platforms open instead of every linkable route: /about, or /orders/* for everything below (since 0.11.0).

android_package.description: The Android application id, like com.example.shop.

android_sha256.description: The SHA-256 fingerprints of the signing certificates, as keytool -list -v prints them.

ios_app_id.description: The Team ID, a dot and the bundle id, like ABCDE12345.com.example.shop.

ios_entitlements.description: A .entitlements file under ios/ that fsp links edits (since 0.11.0).

android_manifest.description: The AndroidManifest.xml under android/ that fsp links edits (since 0.11.0).

flavors.description: One app per build flavour, instead of the keys for one app (since 0.11.0).

out.description: The folder fsp links writes the sitemap and .well-known files into, or false for none (since 0.12.0).

maestro.description: What fsp maestro writes: one smoke flow per route (since 0.7.0). Only fsp maestro checks the values.

app_id.description: Android and iOS: the application or bundle id, or a Maestro variable like ${APP_ID}. Give app_id or url.

url.description: The web: an http or https URL, or a Maestro variable like ${URL}. Give app_id or url.

link.description: What a route's path goes after, like myshop://shop.example.com or http://localhost:8080/#.

out.description: The folder the flows go in, inside the project.

guard_flow.description: A .yaml flow that gets past the guards, run before a guarded route's link.

timeout.description: How long a flow waits for its page, in milliseconds.

samples.description: The value of each dynamic folder, by its path below the app folder, like products/$id: 1.

size.description: What fsp size checks the web build against (since 0.8.1). Only fsp size checks the values.

build.description: The flutter build web output folder.

route.description: The budget of each deferred route's own and shared chunks together.

routes.description: Budgets per route pattern, like /checkout: 8 KB; each wins over route.

bytes.description: A size: a number of bytes, or a number and B, KB (1,024 bytes) or MB, like 3 MB or 64KB.

test.description: What fsp test writes: a widget smoke test per route (since 0.8.1). Only fsp test checks the values.

out.description: test, integration_test or a folder below one.

setup.description: A .dart file the tests call first. Default: <out>/setup.dart, when it exists.

timeout.description: How long a test waits for its page, in milliseconds of its fake clock.

skip.description: Route patterns, as fsp routes prints them, that get no test.

a11y.description: Check Flutter's accessibility guidelines once each page is on screen: true for all, or some of them (since 0.16.0).

tasks.description: What fsp dev, fsp build and fsp run run (since 0.9.0): a task is a command, or a map with run, before, with, after and env. Only those commands check it.

dev.description: fsp dev: flutter run unless run says otherwise.

build.description: fsp build <target>: flutter build unless run says otherwise.

command.description: A string the shell runs, or a list of words run with no shell. A leading fsp is the fsp that runs the task.

steps.description: A command, or a list of commands run in order; the first that fails stops.

with.description: Long-running commands next to run, one pane each in fsp dev, by name.

env.description: Environment variables for every command of the task.

hot_reload.description: Hot reload on every save; false restarts instead.
